claims: The 2026 National Cherry Blossom Festival in Washington, D.C. runs from March 20 to April 12.
Cherry blossoms usually peak in late March or early April around the Tidal Basin.
Peak bloom is when 70% of Yoshino trees are open.
Peak bloom lasts only a few days.
The Tidal Basin is the most popular peak viewing spot.
Peak viewing spots include East Potomac Park, the U.S. National Arboretum, Dumbarton Oaks, and the U.S. Capitol Grounds.
Significant construction is ongoing to repair the seawall at the southern corner of the Tidal Basin.
The 2026 National Cherry Blossom Festival includes the Opening Ceremony on March 22.
The 2026 National Cherry Blossom Festival includes the Blossom Kite Festival on March 29.
The 2026 National Cherry Blossom Festival includes the Parade on April 12.
Cherry blossoms generally last one to two weeks.
Prime viewing is 4–7 days after the peak bloom begins.
